introductions.title: Superior audio with warmth, healing, and peaceful sleep in mind

body.intro:
I created my own ASMR studio to record this title because I want you to relax and have the ultimate sleeping experience.
I want to provide the peaceful sleep you truly desire. Please put your mind at ease and fall into a deep slumber.
With that in mind, I included sleep-inducing audio techniques that will "stimulate" your ears.
With environmental recordings taken in the heart of nature, there is no doubt you will feel soothed!
There are various situations with different women. This includes super-realistic ear cleaning, ther*peutic inns with scenic vistas, and sound-only scenes without dialogue.
ASMR of encouraging life advice was also recorded.

introductions.title: You'll be able to fall asleep a lot with 17 hours of content!

body.intro:
* 01_Main Story - (Total 4 Hours, 11 Minutes, 58 Seconds)
You meet the proprietress of a traditional Japanese-style inn, and end up staying the night.
Please relax, make yourself comfortable, and forget about your daily woes.

- 01_I have been waiting for you. (04:10)
(Mountainous area sounds, vegetation sounds, river sounds)
- 02_Full-body massage with a foot bath. (15:31)
(Foot bath sounds, sounds of making cold barley tea, massage over clothing, hand massage with lotion, hot towel)
- 03_First-rate shampooing and head massage. (25:52)
(Listening to sounds of nature through an open window, hair brushing sounds, rinsing with carbonated water, realistic shampooing, combing and permeating hair treatment, towel, head massage)
- 04_Ear cleaning with stainless steel ear cleaner and wet cotton swab. (40:52)
(Lap pillow, stainless steel ear cleaner, cleaning both ears, blowing on ears, wet cotton swab)
- 05_Ear cleaning with spiral cotton swab and bamboo ear cleaner. (29:51)
(Lap pillow, spiral cotton swab, bamboo ear cleaner, cotton ball ear cleaner)
- 06_Ear massage with sleep-inducing gel. (31:57)
(Whole ear massage with gel, massaging back of ear, lymphatic massage, towel)
- 07_Full-body oil massage. (26:37)
(Full-body massage with lots of oil)
- 08_Ear washing and massage. (44:33)
(Sounds of lathering, ear washing, towel, foamy towel massage, shaving fine hair on ears, hot towel, cotton ball ear cleaner, thick cotton swab massage, body milk, tapping)
- 09_Sleeping next to one another. (20:52)
(Night breeze sounds, patting of a comforter, head petting, sleeping side-by-side)
- 10_Reading on a rainy day. (11:48)
(Rain sounds, sounds of flipping pages in a book, sleeping sounds)


* 02_ASMR To Soothe And Induce Sleep - (Total 9 Hours, 0 Minutes, 50 Seconds)
High-quality audio versions of situations uploaded to YouTube.

- 01_It's comfy! A massage that puts you into the deepest slumber. (1:17:52)
(Gel ball, massage over a towel, shiatsu massage, gel, lotion, cotton cloth, brush, carbonated skin lotion)
- 02_99.9% fall asleep immediately! Cognitive shuffling sleep technique. (1:02:21)
(Improved version of YouTube video. Please listen together with the undersea sounds.)
- 03_Daughter does her best for her dad. (1:11:17)
(Shoulder pounding, towel, shampooing, ear massage, onomatopoeia, bamboo ear cleaner, blowing on ears, lap pillow, head caressing, hugging)
- 04_It feels too good! 12 kinds of deep ear cleaning that will reach your eardrum. (1:28:55)
(Collection of exhaling sounds and 12 kinds of ear-cleaning sounds.)
- 05_Realistic sleeping sounds while spooning. Deep sleep-inducing. (1:00:03)
(Cotton cloth, deep breathing, head caressing, onomatopoeia, lap pillow, shoulder massage, head massage, sleeping side-by-side)
- 06_Enjoy the best sleep with an oil massage from a first-rate masseuse. (1:35:56)
(Oil massage, oil shampooing, oil cotton swab, cotton ball ear cleaner, bamboo ear cleaner, ear massage)
- 07_Head spa at a first-class barber shop before falling asleep. (1:24:26)
You can experience a first-class barber shop without any dialogue.
(Head massage, shampooing, fine hair shaving, towel, cotton swab, cotton ball ear cleaner, hair cutting, lotion massage, oil massage, face tapping)


* 03_Girls You'll Surely Like - (Total 1 Hour, 28 Minutes, 37 Seconds)

- 01_Ear cleaning of both ears by two girls. (14:10)
(Both your ears will be cleaned by an untanned and tanned girl.)
- 02_Coffee girlfriend. (10:21)
(She will make coffee to help you with your fatigue.)
- 03_Ear cleaning with your older sister in stockings. (14:05)
(You get spoiled by your older sister when she comes home.)
- 04_A naughty sister cleans her brother's ears (17:44)
(Your sister, who has a slightly low-pitched voice, will clean your ears.)
- 05_Let's get spoiled a lot by Mommy. (10:11)
(You're welcome! Mommy will always spoil you.)
- 06_Ear cleaning by a cheeky lady who isn't afraid to call you a wimp. (22:06)
(You get verbally teased by a cheeky lady, and then at the end, something happens...?!)


* 04_Just A Lot Of Sounds (No Dialogue) - (Total 1 Hour, 43 Minutes, 6 Seconds)
There are many sounds. Mostly ear-cleaning sounds.

- 01_Tapping. (06:20)
- 02_Deep ear massage. (06:44)
- 03_Ear cleaning with plastic ear cleaner. (09:24)
- 04_Ear cleaning with bamboo ear cleaner. (10:01)
- 05_Ear cleaning with cotton swab. (19:11)
- 06_Realistic ear cleaning with cotton swab. (09:34)
- 07_Ear cleaning with stainless steel ear cleaner. (09:24)
- 08_Ear cleaning with titanium ear cleaner. (Deep ear version) (10:59)
- 09_Realistic foot massage. (Near ear version) (21:29)
A near ear version was created for individuals who want to listen up close to the sounds of massaging and rubbing against the soles of feet.

* 05_ASMR Of Encouraging Life Advice - (Total 36 Minutes, 16 Seconds)
This was made with the hope that it would benefit people's lives!
- 01_ASMR that is effective when you don't feel well. (17:09)
- 02_ASMR you should listen to when you're having a really tough time. (19:07)

* Free Talk (Voiced Afterword)
- 01_Voiced afterword. (09:08)
I talk about various things.
MP3: 48 kHz / 320 Kbps.
* This product includes both MP3 and WAV files.
* Includes two high-resolution illustrations (with facial expression variations)
* Bonus free talk afterword included (25:14) - WAV format, binaural

body.intro:
Recording Environment:
Recorded in a dedicated studio with soundproofing.
The actual environmental sounds were recorded on-site.
Voices are recorded using high-quality dummy head microphones like the NEUMANN / KU100 and various custom-made mics.
Listening with headphones or earbuds is recommended.
* All tracks in this work are binaural.

Total Recording Time:
Total of 34 tracks: Total recording time of 17 hours, 0 minutes, 47 seconds.
* There is no reused audio in this product. The voiced afterword is not included in the total recording time or track list.
WAV files only: 10.16 GB (Including free talk).
Total file size: 11.54 GB (Of all audio tracks).

File Formats:
WAV: 44.1 kHz / 16 bit.
MP3: 44.1 kHz / 192 Kbps.
* This product includes both MP3 and WAV files.
* Includes a high-resolution illustration.
* Includes free talk (voiced afterword).
* WAV file format / binaural.
